# Third-party license texts

<!-- release-readiness: approved -->

This file contains the license and notice texts for the locked desktop app runtime. Text copied from npm and Cargo archives is verified against the exact lockfile archive digest. Where a .crate archive omits a named license file, package rows link the exact immutable upstream VCS commit and source file hash; SPDX-canonical text is included only where the exact commit license notice or source header points to that standard license. Source-byte SHA-256 values cover the original bytes, including original line endings. Inside each Markdown fence, CRLF is normalized to LF and no source whitespace is trimmed. If an original file lacks a final LF, one LF is added immediately before the closing fence as Markdown framing only. Each heading’s LF-normalized fenced-body SHA-256 covers exactly the bytes inside the fence, including that framing LF; its source-byte SHA-256 remains the hash of the original file.

## Scope and verification

- App runtime only: npm dependency closures for aarch64-apple-darwin and x86_64-pc-windows-msvc, and Cargo normal dependency closures for the same targets. Build, test, development-only, Android-only, and other platform wrapper packages are not represented as app runtime dependencies.
- npm: 47 locked runtime packages on each target; all exact npm archives match package-lock.json SRI, package metadata matches the locked SPDX field, and all 49 license files match the extracted node_modules copies. Re-verified 2026-09-28 after the LW-05 dependency refresh and LW-01 TLS provider switch from aws-lc-rs to ring. and LW-01 TLS provider switch from aws-lc-rs to ring.
- Cargo: 300 runtime crates for macOS arm64 and 305 for Windows x64. Their locked archives contain 600 named license/notice files inventoried here (union of both targets); every .crate SHA-256 matches Cargo.lock, and each recorded license expression comes from the same archive's Cargo.toml metadata.
- Text copied directly from npm/Cargo archives is linked to the exact lock-digested source. Eighteen Cargo archives omit a named full-text license document; their complete terms are supplied from exact immutable upstream files or canonical SPDX v3.27.0 texts explicitly referenced by package metadata and upstream notices/source headers. The supplement table records each immutable source and source-byte SHA-256.

- 2026-09-29 ST-07 incremental verification: tauri-plugin-single-instance@2.5.0 and tracing-attributes@0.1.31 archives match Cargo.lock; their complete named license files are included below. Current normal runtime closure counts are macOS arm64 269 and Windows x64 273 crates (excluding pude); previously verified extra license rows remain for historical dependency versions.

- 2026-10-15 v0.1.2 verification: added exact-archive inventory for 30 previously unlisted locked runtime package versions. Every added npm archive matches its lockfile SRI and every added Cargo archive matches Cargo.lock SHA-256; named license files (or exact-commit upstream license files when omitted from an archive) and newly included full texts are hashed below. Existing verified historical rows remain. Current npm runtime inventory: 48 locked package versions. Current normal Cargo closures (excluding pude): 282 macOS arm64 crates and 283 Windows x64 crates.

- 2026-10-19 v0.1.3 preparation: verified the six updated Tauri/updater package archives against Cargo.lock and their named license texts. Codegen and macro packages are recorded as build-time procedural dependencies. Windows uses raw NSIS update executables with ZIP support disabled; macOS and Linux retain tar.gz update support. Historical dependency rows remain for earlier releases.

- 2026-10-21 incremental verification: rustls-webpki@0.103.16 archive matches Cargo.lock; its ISC license text is unchanged from 0.103.15 and reuses the verified full text below. The earlier package row remains for historical releases.

## Exact source supplements for archive omissions

The listed crates' exact locked .crate archives do not contain a named full-text license file. Each package is mapped through its own .cargo_vcs_info.json commit and Cargo.toml repository/path to the linked immutable upstream file. For objc2, the exact commit LICENSE.md supplies the license-choice mapping and Apple SDK notice, and the linked SPDX canonical texts provide the full selected license terms. For selectors, the exact crate's lib.rs header points to MPL 2.0; the canonical MPL text is included. No copyright holder or year has been inferred or inserted.

## Original license and notice text

Each block below contains complete UTF-8 license/notice wording. Its heading records the SHA-256 of the source bytes and a separate SHA-256 of the exact fenced-body bytes after CRLF-to-LF normalization and any required final LF for Markdown framing. That framing LF is added only when the original source lacks one and is excluded from the source-byte hash. Package inventory rows point to the applicable text block.

## Apple SDKs

These crates are derived from Apple SDKs shipped with Xcode. You can obtain a
copy of the Xcode license at:

https://www.apple.com/legal/sla/docs/xcode.pdf

Or by typing `xcodebuild -license` in your terminal.

From reading the license, it is unclear whether distributing derived works
such as these crates are allowed?

But in any case, to practically use these crates, you will have to link, and
that only works when you have the correct Xcode SDK available to provide the
required `.tbd` files, which is why we choose to still use the normal SPDX
identifiers in the crates (Xcode is required to use the crates, and when using
Xcode you have already agreed to the Xcode license).
~~~~
